scripts.codegen: bun run generate && bun run generate:audit && bun run migrations:bundle
scripts.build:mac: bun run codegen && bun build --compile --minify --target=bun-darwin-arm64 src/main.ts --outfile ../src-tauri/binaries/pdf-backend-aarch64-apple-darwin && rm -f .*.bun-build
scripts.build:mac-x64: bun run codegen && bun build --compile --minify --target=bun-darwin-x64 src/main.ts --outfile ../src-tauri/binaries/pdf-backend-x86_64-apple-darwin && rm -f .*.bun-build
scripts.build:windows: bun run codegen && bun build --compile --minify --target=bun-windows-x64 src/main.ts --outfile ../src-tauri/binaries/pdf-backend-x86_64-pc-windows-msvc.exe && rm -f .*.bun-build
